verdict.rationale: Buzz has named channels/rooms. Threads exist only by implication: an agent benchmark grades 'reply-to-thread' behavior, and agents 'post the threads'. A personalized feed is also mentioned. Nothing shows that every conversation is forced under a named topic or thread, or that threading helps admins catch up on busy channels. missing for 10: documented threading model (thread creation, naming, or topic-per-message organization), evidence that all channel conversations are organized under topics or threads, catch-up features such as unread thread views or summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can catch up on busy channels efficiently because every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread

citations.quote: Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
Spin up a room in seconds. Name it, describe it, make it private.
Personalized feed. What matters to you.
